deadline.value: Applications are due January 5 each year (year inferred).

also.quote: The deadline each year is January 5th.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional, not required.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are optional, not required for admission.

gre_subject.value: The Math Subject GRE is not required; GRE scores in general are optional.
gre_subject.quote: Is the Math Subject GRE required? | Scores for the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are optional, not required for admission.

fee_waiver.value: A waiver is possible under special circumstances by contacting the department.
fee_waiver.quote: Yes, under special circumstances we may be able to waive the fee.

supervisor.value: Students pass qualifying exams first and then choose a thesis adviser.
supervisor.quote: After passing the qualifying examinations, students are expected to select a thesis adviser and form a doctoral committee.

funding.value: The main support is a teaching assistantship (tuition waiver, health insurance, stipend), normally for up to five years; the department supports only doctoral students.
funding.quote: The main source of financial assistance is teaching assistantships. | In most cases, doctoral students are supported for no more than five years.

also.quote: The department offers support exclusively to doctoral students.

entry_route.value: Apply straight to the PhD; the department admits only PhD students and no master's is needed first.
entry_route.quote: No, you may apply directly to the Ph.D. program without a master's degree.

also.quote: We only admit students into our Ph.D. program.

notes: Older department pages (math.psu.edu) show December 30 and GRE required; the current science.psu.edu pages say January 5 and GRE optional.
